verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a reasonable thing to ask of a 2FA authenticator app, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no natural-language command interface. Type-to-search, enteauth://search deep links, the export CLI and llms.txt are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not natural-language operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
